_comment: The Vale's districts (game/districts.py). A point belongs to the district whose nearest seat scores lowest: distance from the point (moved by a gentle noise 'warp', so borders wander) to the seat, plus 'biome_bias' times how far the point is from the district's home biome (lowland, desert or snow), so districts keep to their own ground. A district may have several seats; seats of one district have no border between them. x and z are world units; 'bounds' is the land divided: min x, min z, max x, max z; 'map' is the map they divide and 'terrain_seed' its terrain's seed (other maps have no districts). The borders are baked into that map's paint by hand ('python -m game.tools.bake_districts'; run it again after any change here) and stop at water. Run 'python -m game.tools.district_map' to see them on the world map. A mod's districts.json replaces any value it names (its 'districts' list replaces the whole list).

districts.name: Millbrook
districts.note: The heart of the Vale: Millbrook and its windmill, the lakes of Mirrormere and Reedhollow, Hollin's Cross and the Old Mill.

districts.name: Greywood
districts.note: The scrub at the desert's edge: Greywood, Thornfield, Kingsfall Tower, Brackenford and Fenwick's Lodge.

districts.name: Ashby Reach
districts.note: The northern desert: Ashby, Hunter's Rest, Heron Pool, Raven's Roost and the Gallows Crypt.

districts.name: Cairnmoor
districts.note: The western dunes: Cairnmoor Barrow, the Seven Sisters, Greyfen Tarn, the Drowned Chapel, the Bonepit, and Whisperdeep, where the Ember Wyrm sleeps.

districts.name: Elderbrook
districts.note: The pilgrims' south: Elderbrook, Kettlewick, the Moonwell, the Wanderer's Rest and the Webwood.

districts.name: Wyndham
districts.note: The southeast: Wyndham Cross, Silkhollow, the Sunken Stones and the greenskin warcamp.

districts.name: Furrow End
districts.note: The eastern highlands and their farms: Furrow End, the Pilgrim's Lantern, the Ashen Circle and Rotfang Warren.

districts.name: Emberpeak
districts.note: The mountains above the sea: Emberpeak Pass, Frostcap Tor, Witch's Knoll and Stillwater Tarn.
